about: compiler/nativelower: checked compiler/ir to SysV AMD64 machine code and ELF64 executables (NB-4). Rows written unjudged in the backend crunch (2026-11-27); the judging run is owed.

mutants.name: nativelower-normalize-sign
mutants.from: shiftImm(a, if IntSigned(k) { uint32(7) } else { uint32(5) }, r, n)
mutants.rule: A narrow signed result is sign-extended (SAR), an unsigned one zero-extended (SHR).

mutants.name: nativelower-signed-less
mutants.from: return if signed { objfmt.X64CondL } else { uint8(0x2) }
mutants.rule: A signed less-than branches on JL, never the unsigned JB.

mutants.name: nativelower-second-result-register
mutants.from: storeWord(a, c.fr, d, w, if rw == 0 { rax } else { rdx })
mutants.rule: A two-word result comes back in RAX then RDX, as SysV returns a 16-byte value.

mutants.name: nativelower-record-field-order
mutants.rule: A field's word is the words of the fields before it.

mutants.name: nativelower-local-call-alias
mutants.rule: A call of a function of the package resolves to that function's offset in .text.

mutants.name: nativelower-write-pointer
mutants.rule: The string entry writes Main's bytes: pointer in RSI, length in RDX, to ergo_write.
